title: QLoRA, adapters, and prefixes
summary: How the common parameter-efficient methods differ at train time and at serve time.

choices.text: QLoRA stores the frozen base in a 4-bit quantization and trains the LoRA factors in higher precision, so optimizer state is kept for the adapter rather than for every base weight.
Raising the LoRA rank always increases the effective step size, because alpha/r grows with r when alpha is held fixed.
A Houlsby adapter is a small bottleneck MLP inserted on the sublayer path. Unless it is fused, those extra layers still run at inference.
Prefix tuning learns continuous key/value prefixes in the blocks. Prompt tuning learns a soft prompt only on the input embeddings. Both occupy sequence positions.
